test_title: PYST 46 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect voice.

He said, "I spoke with my parents yesterday."

options.text: He said that he spoke with his parents the previous day.
He said that he should have speak with his parents the previous day.
He said that he had spoken with his parents the previous day.
He said that he would speak with his parents the day before.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** In indirect speech, the tense of the verb changes according to the reporting verb's tense. Here, "spoke" in direct speech changes to "had spoken" in indirect speech as the reporting verb "said" is in the past tense.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"yesterday" becomes "the previous day"**
 
 
• In indirect speech, time expressions are adjusted according to the context.
 
 
 
• **"I spoke" becomes "he had spoken"**
 
 
• The pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to match the subject of the reporting clause.
 
• The verb "spoke" is changed to "had spoken" to reflect the past perfect tense.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation:**
 
 
• Direct speech quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
• The sentence follows proper grammatical structure without punctuation marks used in direct speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *He said that he had spoken with his parents the previous day.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He said that he spoke with his parents the previous day."
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "spoke" should be changed to "had spoken" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "He said that he should have speak with his parents the previous day."
 
 
• Incorrect modal verb and grammar: "should have speak" is ungrammatical.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He said that he would speak with his parents the day before."
 
 
• Incorrect tense and time expression: "would speak" is future tense and "the day before" does not match the context.
